# DNA - Digital Nursing Assistant

> DNA is a mobile application designed to streamline nursing workflows, digital clinical records, SBAR handovers, and accurate dosage calculations.

## Main Features
- Patient Management: Register patients and maintain comprehensive digital records.
- SOAP Notes: Structured clinical documentation.
- SBAR Handovers: Safe and clear shift handovers.
- Calculations & Meds: Dosage and IV drip-rate calculators.
